message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: operating small electroplating without permits, no wastewater treatment, discharging waste water containing heavy metal chromium 12 mg/L, exceeding standards three times. Violation of environmental protection laws. Likely crime: "非法排放危险废物罪" or "污染环境罪". Under Chinese Criminal Law, Article 338 (formerly 338) deals with "污染环境罪" (environmental pollution crime). Also possibly "非法排放危险废物罪" under Article 338? Actually Article 338: "违反国家规定，排放、倾倒、处置危险废物或者其他有毒有害物质，造成严重污染环境的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑，并处罚金或者没收财产。" So the crime is "污染环境罪". Also could be "非法排放危险废物罪" but that's same article. The prompt says "以环境污染罪追究其刑责任". So answer: 环境污染罪. Use law term: "污染环境罪". So output: [罪名]污染环境罪<eoa>
